name: Philips Hue
description: Philips Hue bridges on the LAN through the CLIP v1 REST API over plain HTTP: link-button pairing, one canvas subdevice per colour lamp, at most 10 light commands per second per bridge, lamp state restored on shutdown. Written from Philips' public developer documentation. Untested: nobody working on HueDeck owns a Hue bridge. Notes: docs/hardware/philips-hue.md.
